name: set_face
description: Switch the watch face of one or both round screens.

face.description: classic: temperature, clock, power, load ring and fan; rings: load, temperature and memory rings; plus: classic with a memory bar and numbers; bar: classic with a small memory bar; claude: Claude Code usage limits and tokens; clawd: animated Claude Code mascot

screen.description: left is the CPU screen, right the GPU screen

name: set_rotation
description: Turn one or both screens clockwise, for a board that sits another way round.

screen.description: left is the CPU screen, right the GPU screen

name: set_brightness
description: Set the backlight of one or both screens; 0 turns it off.

screen.description: left is the CPU screen, right the GPU screen

name: show_text
description: Show a short message over the watch face for a few seconds.

text.description: Letters without accents show best; accented ones lose the accent

screen.description: left is the CPU screen, right the GPU screen

name: set_mic
description: Mute or unmute the microphone. Muted, the board doesn't listen for its wake word.

name: set_wake_word
description: Choose the word the board listens for before a voice command. The board remembers it.

word.description: alexa: say Alexa (default); hiesp: say Hi ESP

name: set_volume
description: Set the speaker volume the board talks with; 0 is silent. The board remembers it.

name: get_state
description: Read the board's state: firmware, uptime, whether metrics are live, each screen's face, rotation and brightness, the voice state (wake word, muted, listening), the speaker volume and how busy the UI is.
